$comment: Canonical list of CDP data categories. Each use case references these by id in its dataCategories array, so a client can say which kinds of data they already have and see which ideas they could run today (the 'data readiness' filter). Keep ids in sync with the enum in data/schema.json.

categories.label: Browsing & on-site behavior
categories.description: Page and product views, searches, clicks, session activity, and in-app events.

categories.label: Purchase & order history
categories.description: Past orders, baskets, returns, spend, and transaction records.

categories.label: Loyalty & membership
categories.description: Points, tiers, rewards, subscriptions, and membership status.

categories.label: Declared preferences & profile
categories.description: Data customers share directly: quizzes, sizes, style, communication preferences, and profile fields.

categories.label: Email & message engagement
categories.description: Opens, clicks, send history, channel consent, and response to campaigns or notifications.

categories.label: Location & context
categories.description: Geography, device, time, weather, and other real-time context.

categories.label: Product, inventory & service data
categories.description: Catalog, pricing, availability, vehicle or asset records, and service history.

categories.label: Reviews & feedback
categories.description: Ratings, reviews, survey responses, and customer feedback.

categories.label: Predictive scores & segments
categories.description: Modelled signals such as churn risk, propensity, affinity, lifecycle stage, and inferred interests.

categories.label: Account & firmographic data
categories.description: B2B company, domain, CRM, and prospect or account records.

categories.label: Third-party & audience data
categories.description: Data from ad platforms, social networks, and external or enrichment sources.
